Article 1.3: Account Sizes and Pricing

Warren's summary

Summarize this rule

OG accounts are no longer sold. Existing OG accounts keep their rules.

Standard MAX and STEADY: Prices
Account Size	Standard MAX	STEADY
$25,000	$148	$149
$50,000	$178	$229
$100,000	$348	$308
$150,000	$408	$585
$250,000	$658	$750

Evaluation resets cost $100 on Standard MAX accounts at every size. STEADY evaluation resets are tiered by account size: $114 (25K), $180 (50K), $270 (100K), $480 (150K), $620 (250K). Discounts are available via Discord. Exhibition resets have separate fees (see Article 6.2). Activation to funded costs $120 unless waived by a promotion. STEADY accounts have no activation fee (Article 2.5).
